notablePrerequisites: An additional nonartifact enchantment creature in your graveyard with a mana value of four or greater.
description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying {3}{B}.
Last Voyage of the _____ enters the battlefield, triggering its own first ability, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Last Voyage of the _____ trigger, returning a nonartifact enchantment creature with mana value four or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Last Voyage of the _____ to it.
The enchantment creature enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Last Voyage of the _____ from the battlefield to your hand.
Last Voyage of the _____'s last abililty triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Last Voyage of the _____ from your hand onto the battlefield.
Last Voyage of the _____ enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 3.
